description: 산림청_사방댐 정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 산림청. 산림청 사방댐 정보 서비스는 산사태 및 토사 유출을 저감하기 위해 구축된 사방댐의 위치와 관리 현황을 표준화하여 제공하는 오픈 API입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 산림청. Its tags are 산림청, 산사태, 사방댐 정보, 관리기관, 시설관리번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
